description.narrative: Prioritized newborn and child health care interventions were strengthened through updating national guidelines for implementation. Systems in selected states were strengthened to monitor progress on maternal, newborn and child survival through establishment of the Child Death Surveillance and Response (CDSR) mechanism, although constraints remain for real-time monitoring through m-Health platform. | Status:Met | As-of Date:30/11/2017
